title: Node.js Modules and Packages
description: Understand how Node.js uses modules to organize code, and how to use npm packages to extend functionality.

lessons.title: What are Modules in Node.js?
lessons.content: Modules are reusable blocks of code whose existence does not accidentally impact other code. Node.js uses CommonJS modules where each file is a module.

lessons.title: Built-in Core Modules
lessons.content: Node.js comes with several built-in modules like `fs` for file system operations, `http` for server creation, `path` for handling file paths, and others.

lessons.title: Creating Your Own Modules
lessons.content: Learn how to create your own modules by exporting functions, objects, or variables using `module.exports` and importing them using `require()`.

lessons.title: Using npm Packages
lessons.content: npm is a vast repository of open-source packages. Learn how to search, install, update, and uninstall packages using npm commands.

lessons.title: package.json File
lessons.content: The `package.json` file holds metadata about the project and its dependencies. Learn how to manage this file and understand its key fields.

lessons.title: Semantic Versioning (SemVer)
lessons.content: Understand versioning of npm packages using SemVer: Major.Minor.Patch, and how it impacts dependency management.
